prompt.image: deep indigo night-sky observatory plate, brass meridian rings and etched magnitude ticks, fine constellation lines, one warm star, subtle nebula, cinematic rim light, no text, no logos. Palette bg:#05070f, surface:#0b1224, paper:#f2eee2, accent:#8fd8ff, warning:#ff7a4d, stamp:#d8a54a. Type NotoSerifSC 600/900/Geist/Geist Mono. Motifs: star chart, brass meridian ring, constellation line, magnitude label, aperture. Composition: leave deliberate negative space for a headline; no readable text, no logos, no letters.
prompt.video: 救援: 乱局 → 诊断 → 修复 → 恢复 → 落版. Motion: sky rotate, star ignition, constellation draw, aperture iris, eclipse wipe. Transition: 日食擦除. Captions: 左上图版题. Sound: 星图音. Hook pattern: [时间]，找到 [目标]。. Avoid the reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, transition combination, caption animation, motifs and SFX arrangement.
prompt.cover: 3:4 star-atlas poster, one oversized brass aperture ring in lower half, a single bright star and constellation lines, deep indigo with warm brass, top negative space for headline. Hook: 倒计时. Hero motif: star chart. Brand block at bottom; keep key text in the top 75% and the right 120px clear. Render all text in HTML/SVG, not in the generated image.
prompt.negative: reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, light sweep, halftone wipe, flash white, center keyword sticker, metal title slam, riser/whoosh/shimmer, gibberish Chinese text, logos, watermarks
